items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So I told Paul, Paul had been kind of missing little things. I said, 'You know, Paul, you got to watch your cues now.' ... Paul said, 'No, no, he digs me like a son.'

ctx.x: Wasn't Andy at one time associated with the same school as Whiteman in Denver?

Yeah, out in -- yeah, with Paul out in Denver. He's from Denver. Yeah, yeah, that's right. He was a -- seemed like -- I think now that he took lessons from Paul's father or something, but they were associated. They were very close together. He's from Denver. That's true.

So, you know, it didn't never worry me because I always felt that -- you know, I don't ever blame myself for something I don't know, you know. Hell, I didn't know. I went the way I felt, you know, I wasn't ready to leave then. I wanted to stay…
Were you aware of Benny Goodman then?
